spans.s:
ind.
To-day.
E.
इदम् this; an irregular formation.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
1 First, initial.
2 Edible, what is to be or may be eaten.
n. (-द्यं)
1

Food.
f. (-द्या)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
आदि and ण्यत् affix, fem. टाप्.

m. (-नः)
The period of a current day, from midnight to midnight in the usual acceptation, but sometimes considered to begin and end with sun-set.
mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Of or belonging to the current day, of to-day.
E.
अद्य, and द्युल् aff.

m. (-तः)
In grammar, the aorist past.
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Past or gone to-day, i. e. any time previous to to-day.
E.
अद्यतन of to-day, भूत been.

ind.
Even now, still.
E.
अद्य, and अपि certainly.

n. (-धि)
Beginning or ending with the current day, from or till to-day.
E.
अद्य, and अवधि limit.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Near to any event, at the point of death &c.
f. (-ना)
A woman or any female animal near the time of delivery.
E.
अद्य, and श्व to-morrow, affix स्व, what will happen to-day or to-morrow.

m. (-विः)
A name of VĀLMĪKI, author of the Rāmāyaṇa.
E.
आद्य first, and कवि a poet, being the first who wrote Sansscrit verse.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
From the beginning to the end.
n. (-न्तं)
Beginning and end, first and last.
E.
आदि first, and अन्त last.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Finite, having beginning and end.
E.
आदि beginning, अन्त end, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-कः)
A Māṣa, a weight equal to five Gunja or Ratti seeds, about 17(1/2) grains troy.
E.
आद्य and माषक a Māṣa, the primary Māṣa; also माष and मास.

n. (-जं)
A primary cause.
E.
आद्य and वीज seed, cause.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Shamelessly voracious.
2 Without the beginning.
E.
आङ्, दिव to play or enjoy in the part. past., or आदि first, and ऊन minus.

adv. (-न्तं)
From first to last.
E.
आद्य and उप near, अन्त end.
